protocol: First 100 by SHA256(filename); fixed pretrained Tesseract kan, OEM1 PSM8, no tuning/training. NFC and outer whitespace normalization only. Codepoint CER, not grapheme CER.
limitations: Modern printed word crops, not historical stone or full-page/line OCR.
Small deterministic sample, not the full benchmark.
Published labels used without independent expert review.
